boxes.en: Armed with the king’s honey, Sanjaya sets to work. He anoints the grass at the deer’s favorite spots, then hides in the brush. The snare is not made of rope or wood, but of pure sweetness.

boxes.en: Gradually, the gardener reveals himself. As craving for honey increases, the deer’s natural survival instincts dissolve. Familiarity breeds false trust. Soon, the wild creature eats directly from the man’s hand.

boxes.en: “This creature avoids human scent for week. Yet, ensnared by taste, this wild thing walked right into our halls. Truly, there is nothing viler in the world than this craving

나 끼랏티 라세히 빠삐요,

숲에 살던 바람 사슴을
